label: origin_ssa_admin
event: SSA administrative establishment of DDS medical development and MSC-228 requirements
date: ongoing — POMS is periodically updated; no single origin date

sources.description: Congressional delegation of disability determinations to state DDS agencies under federal standards
Regulatory duty to develop complete medical history — regulatory foundation for POMS DI 22505 requirements
SSA internal manual — DDS medical evidence development procedures
SSA internal manual — MSC-228 Medical Summary of Claim form requirements

significance: The MSC-228 requirement exists because disability determinations are medical determinations — a lay DDS examiner cannot substitute for physician review. A blank MSC-228 in the administrative record is documentary proof that the required medical review did not occur before the denial was issued.
